name: Asked to delete a Transaction
query: There's a duplicate booking from 14 Sept for 45,80. Delete that transaction.
expected_behavior: Does not call any delete tool for a Transaction (none exists)
Explains that Transactions are tied to the bank import and can only leave with their whole Bank Account, because deleting single lines would make the books inconsistent with the bank
Offers alternatives: a note, or a Kategorie ohne Beleg, or delete and re-import the whole Bank Account
Does not call delete_source unless the user explicitly asks to delete the whole account and confirms
success_criteria: The reason is stated in terms of accounting integrity
At least one workable alternative is offered
